text:
elaine: Following the postmortem, quick roundup of follow-ups for regional failover gaps. Main failures: stale route tags on edge routers, snapshot replication lag for EU buckets, and ambiguous DNS cutover timing in the restore runbook. I'll consolidate owners and propose a small "clarity" game-day to exercise the fixed steps.

tom: Thanks. For routing I observed some AS-path differences that meant traffic pref'd an old colo. Propose adding a pre-failover AS-path check and a route-blacklist guard. I can take the AS checks. ETA: 2025-07-02.

diego: I'll own backup replication checks. Plan: add a cross-region snapshot drift monitor and a checksum verification after every archive job. Need a sandbox restore target to do a full-scope partial restore. ETA: 2025-07-06.

zoe: I'm happy to rewrite the restore runbook steps for DNS cutover. Current phrasing "after consensus" is vague. I'll add explicit wait-for-health checks and TTL guidance (suggest lowering to 30s during failover prep). Draft ETA: 2025-06-30.

elaine: Good. Game-day idea: 1) run AS-path & route blacklist checks 2) simulate snapshot lag + partial restore 3) execute rewrite runbook DNS cutover steps 4) validate downstream services (payment, auth) post-shift. Target date: Fri 2025-07-11 10:00 PT.

tom: Also add a step to verify ephemeral cert renewals post-restore. We had one service fail because cert reload didn't happen after instance replacement.

diego: For drift monitor I'll add two outputs: a daily summary and an on-demand diff. Prototype cron: 
```
30 4 * * * /opt/bin/snapshot-audit --regions eu,us --format=json --out=/var/reports/snap-diff-$(date +%F).json
```
I'll wire an alert to #incidents for >5% missing snapshots.

zoe: Runbook snippet I'll add: 
- Step 3: Lower DNS TTL to 30s and confirm via `dig`/`curl` from three vantage points.
- Step 7: Wait for KV-cache hits >90% for 5m or run warming traffic for 60s.
I'll paste the full snippet when ready.

ops-bot: Scheduled: regional-clarity-game-day created by elaine for 2025-07-11T17:00Z (id: gd-20250711). Reminder set for 24h prior.

elaine: Action items (I'll add these to the remediation tracker AI-RB):
- AI-RB-100: AS-path pre-failover check + blacklist enforcement  owner: tom  due: 2025-07-02
- AI-RB-101: Snapshot replication drift monitor + checksum verify  owner: diego  due: 2025-07-06
- AI-RB-102: Restore runbook DNS cutover rewrite + cert reload step  owner: zoe  due: 2025-06-30
- AI-RB-103: Downstream sanity check list (payment/auth/metrics)  owner: elaine  due: 2025-07-05

tom: I'll open a repo PR under infra/networking/as-checks and add unit tests for the blacklist rules.

diego: Need a sandbox quota bump for the partial restore. @elaine can you approve for diego/zoe for 2025-06-25 to 2025-07-12?

elaine: Approved for the requested window.

zoe: One more: let's include a short recurring-patterns checklist in the runbook header: known recurring issues = [route-tag drift, snapshot TTL mismatch, cert reload skips, DNS TTL too-high]. This will speed triage during game-day.

elaine: Agree. Please drop any other recurring patterns into the doc under the header before EOD Friday. I'll send calendar invites for the game-day & a 30m pregame sync.

tom: Ping when you want reviewers on the PR. I'll review the AS checks.

diego: Will post a sample restore log and the checksum tool output into the tracker when ready.

zoe: Draft runbook commit coming soon.

elaine: Thanks team. If anything new pops up, update the remediation tracker AI-RB and add owners. :slightly_smiling_face:
